findings.title: [P2] Handle failed process enumeration before reading stdout
findings.explanation: descendants() calls trim() on spawnSync('ps').stdout without checking spawn failure. In this environment ps returns EPERM and null stdout, reproducing the crash retained in both CI logs. The same helper runs during completion and limit handling, so the exception also interrupts cleanup. Handle enumeration failure explicitly while preserving owned-process termination and retain a regression for unavailable ps.

findings.title: [P2] Wire hooks for the enclosing repository and app directory
findings.explanation: The prepare command runs Husky inside app/, where no .git exists; installation reports '.git can't be found' and core.hooksPath is unset. Additionally, .husky/pre-commit changes to the enclosing root, where its pinned lint-staged command cannot resolve. Configure installation from the Git root targeting app/.husky and execute checks from app/. Removing the read-only restriction alone would not fix these paths.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve source bytes when archiving delivered projects
findings.explanation: This inherited harness helper applies log redaction to source after hashing its original bytes. The retained delivered archive has five manifest mismatches; redaction introduces unterminated expressions in HTTP and MCP-host source and invalid syntax in proof-policy tests. Preserve source byte-for-byte, sanitize runtime observations separately, and verify hashes against archived bytes. This is a harness retention defect; the live app source is intact.
